hooks.name: Playbook logger
hooks.description: When an agent execution completes, appends a one-line entry to section 6 of docs/KIRO_PLAYBOOK.md so the write-up builds itself.

action.prompt: Append one Markdown table row to the "## 6. Log" table in docs/KIRO_PLAYBOOK.md summarizing the task that was just completed. Use the columns: Time (current local time, HH:MM), Task (short description of what was done), Kiro feature (spec task / hook / steering / MCP / property test / scaffold / other), What happened (one sentence outcome). Only append a single new row to the existing table; do not modify any other part of the file. If the task was trivial or purely conversational with no repo change, skip it and do nothing.
